name: PMC building rules (FSI and TDR)
title: Pune building rules: FSI, TDR and road widening, latest
summary: The Pune Municipal Corporation's rules on how much a builder may build on a plot (FSI), the development rights it may buy or load (TDR), and the conditions tied to road widening.
means: Extra floors built on premium FSI or TDR need their approvals. For a building on a road marked for widening, ask the builder for the sanctioned plan and whether its extra FSI was granted before 27 November 2026.

history.status: The Bombay High Court issued notice to the state and the Pune Municipal Corporation on a public interest petition challenging the rules that allow more FSI in Pune.

Premium FSI and TDR along roads earmarked for widening are withheld until the whole stretch is widened on the ground, under a Pune Municipal Corporation circular for building proposals submitted from 27 November 2026.
